__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is a tall, thin boy.  He is looking for his gang mates.  He and his
mates have cost city authorities many millions of creds a week in
vandalism repairs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A juve is standing here plotting mischief.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle juve

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This punk is from one of the rowdiest, scruffiest, and definitely most
fashionable of all gangs -- the Grunge Mongers.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A punk is here plotting a crime wave.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle punk

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A sad victim of Future Shock, this man is immensely dangerous and will
not be stopped by anyone who tries to deter him from revenge upon the
Justice Department.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Futsie is here reciting Monty Python sketches.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle futsie

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A member of a local Block's Citi-Def militia, this man is well-armed
and undersupervised.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Citi-Def Militiaman is here contemplating a Block War.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle citi-def militiaman

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He blends into the crowd as his hand travels into another citizen's pocket.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A dunk is here blending into the crowd.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dunk

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A practitioner in Mega-City One's largest growth industry, mugging, is
looking you over for a possible business transaction.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A tap is here eyeing your belongings.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle tap

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
A member of Mega-City One's Justice Department is here considering what
crimes you have committed.  Being a rookie he will probably be easier on
you though.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Rookie judge is on his first beat here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle rookie judge

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Wallaby Gleep is a heavy-set man who gives you the impression that he is
unintelligent and unimaginative, but looks can be deceiving.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Mr. Gleep is here wanting to know what you want.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle wallaby gleep

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is a thin angular crook, pretty close to everyone's idea of Ebeneezer
Scrooge.  Indeed, the only thing guaranteed to bring a spark to his dead
eyes is the mention of money.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Pinky Throt is here Wringing his hands.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pinkerton throt

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Ramirez is a dour man who knows that he's never going to get a better
deal out of life.  He is content to run the bite fights for Throt and
Gleep.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Ernie Ramirez is here collecting for the mob.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ernie ramirez

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He is a dedicated, if somewhat pessimistic Judge.  He is the Senior Judge
of the Downtown Quadrant.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Judge Eckersely is here shaking down a Perp.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle judge eckersely

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Beddows is a clone from the same stock as the ex-Chief Judge McGruder.
She is fanatically dedicated to her job and has no ambitions other than
to enforce the LAW.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Judge Beddows is here calling Resyk.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle judge beddows

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A bite fighter is here with sharpened teeth and a bad attitude.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bite fighter is here sharpening his teeth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bite fighter
